samples.question: The top reference panel shows a gray horizontal track with one dark marker sitting on it at some position along the track. Below, three candidate panels A, B, C each show a gray horizontal track (of a possibly different length) with a colored marker. Compare each marker's position relative to its own track: one-quarter, one-half, or three-quarters of the way along. Which candidate's marker is at the same fractional position along its own track as the reference marker?
